module_orientation.notes: Every initial agent-entry response already includes this compact module index. Before the first command in a module, enter /v1/agent/modules/{module_id} for the complete permission-aware command, workflow, relationship, and task-relevance guide.

preflight_hierarchy.notes: Run before mutation-heavy work to confirm the selected board scope and hierarchy shape.

board_scan.notes: Use for compact whole-board scans on memory-heavy boards.

full_card.notes: Use when you need the full description or detailed card context.

full_board_snapshot.notes: Use sparingly when you intentionally need every card body in one response.

knowledge_tree.notes: Use this as the first Notes/Knowledge read. An empty tree means the API is reachable but no project-native notes exist yet.

knowledge_search.notes: Use after reading the tree when looking for existing notes/pages before creating or updating project knowledge.

knowledge_links.notes: Use to find typed links between notes, cards, files, and project entities.

preflight_hierarchy.check: Verify every returned `card.board_id` matches the requested board.
preflight_hierarchy.failure_mode: Fail closed on mismatch and do not mutate Kanban state.

deployment_truth.check: Before deployment, promotion, live-health, rollback, or recovery work, and before claiming what is live, healthy, observable, or recoverable, enter the Deploy module and read its shared workspace plus current dated observations. Treat Deploy as a read-only truth and instruction contract: it records no command execution, and positive live or recovery claims require fresh evidence.
deployment_truth.failure_mode: Do not infer live, healthy, observable, or recoverable state from instructions or stale observations.
